description: Unit tests for WindowsSystemProxyResolutionService in Chromium, mocking WindowsSystemProxyResolver to verify proxy resolution behavior on Windows.

classes.name: MockRequest
classes.description: Mock implementation of WindowsSystemProxyResolver::Request that immediately invokes callback with preset results.

classes.name: MockWindowsSystemProxyResolver
classes.description: Mock implementation of WindowsSystemProxyResolver for testing, allows setting proxy list, status, and error.

classes.name: WindowsSystemProxyResolutionServiceTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing WindowsSystemProxyResolutionService with mocked resolver.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, skips if not supported, creates mock resolver and proxy resolution service.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Returns the proxy resolution service instance.

methods.name: DoResolveProxyTest
methods.description: Performs proxy resolution and verifies the result matches expected proxy list.
